title: The extended alternating Cech complex of a Koszul regular sequence is concentrated in the top degree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the extended alternating Cech complex of a Koszul regular sequence has cohomology only in the top degree. The proof first uses that a Koszul regular sequence remains Koszul regular when its last element is replaced by any power, and that any permutation of a Koszul regular sequence is again Koszul regular, so that any or all of the elements may be replaced by powers while keeping the sequence Koszul regular. For such a sequence the Koszul complex has cohomology concentrated in degree zero, and the identification of the extended alternating Cech complex with a colimit of these Koszul complexes transfers the vanishing to it.
